conflicts.statement: The allowed paths omit mcp.json and .codex-plugin/plugin.json, so they cannot express either documented pairing.

findings.statement: Frozen paths allow root plugin.json and .mcp.json but omit both documented pairings: portable root plugin.json plus mcp.json, and compatibility .codex-plugin/plugin.json plus .mcp.json. BOOTSTRAP-PACKAGE and BOOTSTRAP-MCP therefore have a manifest-path GAP.
The package page distinguishes portable mcp.json from compatibility .mcp.json and requires a transport type for portable MCP entries; it does not establish stdio support for the portable layout.

objective: Compare official layouts with frozen paths.

recommendation.rationale: Do not invent extensions.com.openai.mcpServers or claim root portable .mcp.json wiring. Keep server usable and reconcile paths before install wiring.

source_refs.claim: The official package page documents portable root plugin.json plus mcp.json, and the supported compatibility layout .codex-plugin/plugin.json plus .mcp.json; the compatibility manifest references requested files. It warns not to merely rename .mcp.json because portable MCP entries declare a transport type. Supports BOOTSTRAP-PACKAGE and BOOTSTRAP-MCP; portable stdio remains GAP-BOOTSTRAP-PORTABLE-STDIO.
